abstract: AIM OF THE STUDY: To review management and outcomes in patients with stage I seminoma after orchidectomy. MATERIAL AND METHODS: Between 1979 and 2004 a total 292 patients with stage I seminoma were treated with adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy or were placed on surveillance. Median age at diagnosis was 36 years (range 20-69), with median follow-up 76.5 months (range 11-294). Of the patients, 200 (68.5%) were treated with adjuvant chemotherapy, 72 (24.6%) were irradiated and 20 (6.8%) were placed on surveillance. RESULTS: The probability of 5-year overall survival and relapse-free survival for the entire group was 100% and 95.1% respectively. The 5-year relapse-free survival for adjuvant chemotherapy was 97.2%, for radiotherapy 94.6%, and 31.4% for the surveillance group. Of 24 (8.4%) patients who had relapse in lymph nodes and/or internal organs, 14/20 patients were in the surveillance group. All patients who had a relapse were salvaged successfully with chemotherapy. The toxicity of chemotherapy and radiotherapy was acceptable. No severe reactions were observed. CONCLUSION: Our results confirm the excellent prognosis for patients with stage I seminoma after orchidectomy treated with adjuvant chemotherapy or radiotherapy. The high rate of relapse in our surveillance group suggests the necessity of adjuvant treatment.
abstract_ja: 目的:精巣摘除術後の病期Iセミノーマ患者の管理と転帰を検討すること。対象と方法:1979年から2004年の間に、精巣摘除後の病期Iセミノーマ患者292例が補助化学療法もしくは放射線療法を受けるか、サーベイランスに置かれた。診断時の年齢中央値は36歳(範囲20〜69歳)、追跡期間中央値は76.5か月(範囲11〜294か月)であった。患者のうち200例(68.5%)が補助化学療法を受け、72例(24.6%)が照射を受け、20例(6.8%)がサーベイランスに置かれた。結果:全体の5年全生存期間(全生存率)は100%、無再発生存率は95.1%であった。リンパ節および/または臓器に再発した24例(8.4%)のうち14/20例はサーベイランス群であった。再発したすべての患者は化学療法によって救済された。化学療法および放射線療法の毒性は許容範囲内であり、重篤な反応は認められなかった。結論:精巣摘除後の病期Iセミノーマ患者では、補助化学療法または放射線療法により良好な予後が得られることが確認された。サーベイランス群の再発率が高いことから、補助治療の必要性が示唆される。
